edges: Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne leaves the Skylark by parachute near Earth.
The Skylark lands on Crane's Field.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne conspires to sabotage Dick Seaton's spaceship.
Dick Seaton is declared nominal 'Overlord' of Kondal by the Kondalian monarchy.
Dick Seaton finds allies in Prince Dunark and his consort Princess Sitar.
Dick Seaton's marriage to Dorothy Vaneman is solemnized by the Kondalian monarchy.
Dick Seaton and Martin Crane rescue Margaret 'Peg' Spencer along with Dorothy Vaneman.
Dick Seaton sets up a business with Martin Crane to build a spaceship.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne leaves the Skylark by parachute near Earth.
Dick Seaton and his friends obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
Dick Seaton discovers a workable space drive by combining pure copper with Element X.
Dick Seaton returns to Earth after his adventures.

edges: The Skylark returns to Earth laden with jewels, platinum, radium, and Element X.
